verdicts.why: Bakshi impersonates Talbot with the Photostatic Veil in S2#4 'Face My Enemy' to trick Coulson and May; the handover (S2#11) and kidnapping (S2#14) come later and are carried by later stages.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#11
value.text: Once Bakshi is caught, Coulson trades him to Talbot, who wants him for Hydra's attacks and for posing as him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Hydra agent Coulson hands over to Talbot.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The general Coulson hands Bakshi over to.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#14
split.text: Ward and Agent 33 break into Talbot's base and kidnap Bakshi from his cell.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Hydra prisoner kidnapped from Talbot's base.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The general from whose base Bakshi is kidnapped.

verdicts.why: In S2#11 'Aftershocks' Coulson trades Bakshi to Talbot, who lists the Navy wedding massacre, the U.N. attack and impersonating an officer. The kidnapping from Talbot's base by Ward and Agent 33 is S2#14 and was cut from stage 0, so it is kept as a split stage.

Jameson fires Eddie in #2 'The Spider Slayer' and again in #9 'The Alien Costume, Part 2' after John reveals the Rhino; Eddie, evicted, blames Spider-Man in #9. The whole stage holds at #9, before Venom appears in #10.
The SSR's search for Howard starts in S1#1 'Now Is Not the End' after he skips the Congressional hearing; Sousa is in that briefing and brings in photos of Stark for the Stark case the next day.
Hartley is a veteran S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who leads the mercenaries Hunter and Idaho for Coulson; she is not herself described as a mercenary.
Lucian stabs Strange in the Sanctum and the Cloak subdues him; his astral form follows Strange to Metro-General Hospital, where Strange destroys it with the defibrillator charge, killing him.
Wanda's march on Paris, the sorcerers' stand and the deaths of Sara, the London Master and Rintrah all happen in Episode 4; Episode 3 only has them warn of her army.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
value.text: Kora learns that Nathaniel killed her mother, Jiaying, and begins to doubt him. When she lets Daisy go, he shoots her and has her locked up.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
split.text: Nathaniel drains Kora's powers into himself while she is held. Once freed, Kora helps S.H.I.E.L.D. stop the Chronicoms and saves Daisy's life.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Steals Kora's powers after she turns on him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Turns on Nathaniel, who steals her powers, and sides with S.H.I.E.L.D. against him.

verdicts.why: S7#12 'The End Is at Hand' has Kora confront Nathaniel over Jiaying, let Daisy go, and get shot and held. The power draining and her siding with S.H.I.E.L.D. are S7#13, so they move to a split stage instead of being dropped.
Kamala wakes in the remade world and sees Riri trying to tell her it is fake only at the end of Episode 4, the finale.

Krista sides with Billy against Frank from S2#8-9 and draws Madani out for information on the Punisher in S2#10 'The Dark Hearts of Men', then plans with Billy how to break Frank; every fact in the stage holds by #10.

value.text: Jean Grey, a telepath attacking Damage Control, takes control of Frank when he joins Spider-Man to stop her. Frank later shoots at her from a distance, and Spider-Man shields her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A telepath who takes control of Frank. He later shoots at her.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A vigilante who joins Spider-Man against Jean, falls under her control, and later shoots at her.

verdicts.why: Jean possesses Frank to open a DODC vault and he later snipes at her, Spider-Man taking the bullet, so the new facts are right. But Frank does join Spider-Man in pursuing Jean before she possesses him, so that fact is kept.

value.title: What If...?#6
value.text: Pepper suspects Killmonger in Tony's and Rhodey's deaths. Shuri brings her proof, and the two team up to expose him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Doubts Killmonger and teams up with Shuri to expose him.

split.title: What If...?#9
split.text: Pepper and Shuri storm the throne room in Wakanda to bring Killmonger down, but he is already gone.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Storms Killmonger's throne room with Shuri to bring him down.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Killed Tony. Pepper storms his throne room to bring him down.

verdicts.why: Pepper's suspicion and her alliance with Shuri both happen in #6, so the move is right. The raid on the Wakandan throne room is #9, so it moves to a split stage instead of being dropped.
Sarge stabs May through the stomach in S6#12; Izel only cuts her in their sword fight. In S6#13 Simmons injects her with a healing formula and puts her in a cryo-freeze chamber.

In S2#4 'Smoke & Mirrors' Hunt mocks Sousa's leg, but after the fake malaria injection he names Council members Thomas Gloucester and Hugh Jones; Sousa then lets him escape with a listening device on him. 'The Council' is said on screen.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#17
value.text: In Russia, Storm whips up a blizzard to freeze Omega Red solid.

split.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#47
split.text: Omega Red agrees to salvage a sinking Russian submarine only if Storm and Wolverine dive with him, and Storm goes down with him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Makes Storm dive with him to a sinking submarine.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Dives with Omega Red to a sinking submarine.

verdicts.why: Storm freezes Omega Red with a blizzard in #17 'Red Dawn', so the move is right. The submarine dive is #47 'A Deal with the Devil', so it moves to a split stage instead of being dropped.
At the Bulletin in S3#6 Dex aims at Karen but kills Jasper Evans and leaves her alive. Fisk orders her death and in S3#10 Dex attacks Clinton Church to kill her, and Karen knocks him off the balcony.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#23
value.text: Terri Lee teams with Blade and Spider-Man against Morbius and falls for Blade, but they decide a relationship would be too dangerous. Blade kisses her before he rides away.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#48
split.text: Terri and Blade still love each other, and she helps fight his mother, Miriam. They share one last kiss before he leaves to hunt Miriam.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The vampire hunter Terri loves, who leaves to hunt his mother.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The detective who loves Blade and kisses him goodbye.

verdicts.why: The team-up, the romance, the choice that a relationship is too dangerous and Blade's kiss before riding off are all #23 'The Immortal Vampire'. The last kiss before he leaves to hunt Miriam is #48 'The Vampire Queen', so it moves to a split stage instead of being dropped.

In S1#22 Garrett forces Deathlok to aim at Coulson and Fury, but once Ace is safe Mike kills Garrett and ends the season free of Hydra; the wiki lists Fury among his allies, so 'ally' fits where S1 leaves them.

In S1#9 'Front Toward Enemy' Frank recognizes Lewis's voice on the radio and confronts him at O'Connor's house, where Lewis has strapped Curtis to explosives, so Frank's hunt for the bomber starts there.

Shielding Renslayer from Sylvie on Lamentis is only in a deleted scene. In the aired S1#4 Renslayer orders B-15 pruned when found, and B-15 frees Loki and Sylvie and is knocked out by Minutemen. Her custody is first shown in S1#5 and belongs to a later stage.
